== Ingredients ==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] uncooked dried [[Cookbook:Spaghetti|spaghetti]]
* 2–4 [[Cookbook:Sausage|sausages]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|oil]]
* 3–5 tbsp pasta sauce or [[Cookbook:Ketchup|ketchup]]

== Procedure ==

# Bring 2 [[Cookbook:Liter|liters]] water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], and add salt.
# Add the spaghetti to the boiling water, and cook for 3 minutes.
# Add sausages to pasta, and boil for 5 minutes.
# Drain water.
# Add butter to the pasta, then mix in sauce or ketchup.
# Serve.
